description: This file defines the GrainLifecycle class, which manages the lifecycle stages of grains within the Orleans runtime, including migration participants and stage name retrieval.

classes.name: GrainLifecycle
classes.description: Manages grain lifecycle stages and migration participants within Orleans runtime, with logging support.

methods.name: GetMigrationParticipants
methods.description: Returns the collection of registered grain migration participants.

methods.name: AddMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Registers a new grain migration participant to the lifecycle.

methods.name: RemoveMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Removes a grain migration participant from the lifecycle.

methods.name: GetStageName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a lifecycle stage based on its integer identifier.
